newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes slightly higher.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange, which has been sluggish in recent sessions, posted a marginal gain on Friday but traders said the morose mood could linger for a while as the market lacked big buyers.
The GSE All-Share Index edged up 0.19 points to 376.23 from 376.04 points on Wednesday.
Three equities gained and the rest were unchanged. A total of 44,380 shares changed hands, up sharply from 15,520 on Wednesday. Offers outstripped demand by 1.27 million shares to 177,190.
Unilever led the gainers, adding three cedis to 797 cedis.
